title: Gymnosperms

conceptScope.en: COL26.8 accepted-species routing includes living cycads, Ginkgo, conifers and gnetophytes. Current Atlas entities cover the gymnosperm aggregate, cycads, Ginkgo, conifers and Araucariaceae; a gnetophyte dossier and claim-linked fossil or crown ranges remain pending. Legacy range projections are unreviewed.
conceptScope.zh: COL26.8 已接受物种路由包含现生苏铁类、银杏类、针叶树类和买麻藤类。当前图谱实体覆盖裸子植物集合、苏铁类、银杏类、针叶树类和南洋杉科；买麻藤类档案以及关联主张的化石或冠群延限仍待补充。旧版延限投影尚未复核。

limitations: Package dossiers expose the current curated evidence boundary; unavailable fields are explicit and are not inferred.
